liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (5 reviews): Reviewer says Garcia lost the tune here and played bizarre, off-key runs, which the audience tape clearly captures; Reviewer disagrees, saying Garcia stays within the song's framework throughout and never gets lost [7][8][11][13][18]
- **Me And My Uncle** (1 review): Reviewer notes the uncommon lyric variation about the bottle and the jaw [9]
- **West LA Fadeaway** (1 review): Reviewer names it the first-set highlight: Garcia's vocals nailed, band hitting accents, Vince's solo decent, Garcia's last solo blistering [9]
- **Baba O'Riley** (1 review): Reviewer says opening the encore with this contributed to the second set's overwhelming impact [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Baba O'Riley**: rare: 12 archived performances [19]
- **Tomorrow Never Knows**: rare: 12 archived performances [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-05-21.140870.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 168 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd93-05-21.schoeps.gardner.9400.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 170 min; rated 3.14/5 by 14 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the audience tape sounds good, with Garcia's guitar high in the mix; Reviewer calls the audience recording nice sounding; Reviewer calls it an excellent recording [7][8][14]
- **gd1993-05-21.137355.set2.sbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 11 songs; 110 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [6]
- **gd1993-05-21.140856.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 19 songs; 168 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls California shows starting mid-afternoon, set one ending at sunset, set two at night, changing the feel [11]
- Reviewer got only one ticket, leaving a friend outside, and was on blotter, so memories are hazy [12]
- Reviewer's friend, attending since 1974, said he never heard the band play with such raw power [16]
- Reviewer found a ticket on the ground and gave it to someone seeking a miracle ticket; it was his last Dead show [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-05-21.140870.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [1]. Also: Complete show assembled from three sets of masters; this soundboard file set is 16 bit [1]
- **gd93-05-21.schoeps.gardner.9400.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Paul and Tony G.; source: Audience: Schoeps MK21's [3]
- **gd1993-05-21.137355.set2.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Dat Master (Panasonic SV-3700/48k) [6]. Also: Soundboard upload covers only the second set; uploader promises to post the first set once found [6]
- **gd1993-05-21.140856.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Shoreline Amphitheatre](https://www.dead.net/archives/1993/clippings/backstage-pass-shoreline-amphitheatre-0) [20]
- Poster by D.King Gallery: [Grateful Dead May 1993 Shoreline Crew Pass Laminate](https://www.dking-gallery.com/store/Dead_Lam_Shore0593.html) [21]
